summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. All 22 backend pytest tests pass (security hardening + regressions) and frontend E2E flow passes (upload, match, unlock, filter, bulk delete, theme toggle, download zip). Security hardening verified: invalid session_id ('../../x', too short) rejected with 400 on match-passwords/unlock/delete-bulk/merge-pdf; unsupported extensions (.txt, .exe) rejected on upload and replace; >100 files rejected with 400; download Content-Disposition includes both filename="..." and filename*=UTF-8''...; unlock errors return generic message with no Traceback. Regressions verified: full locked PDF flow (upload->locked, match pw123, unlock, download opens without password), download-zip returns zip with original filenames, delete (single+bulk), replace swaps and re-detects, merge-pdf merges >=2 and rejects <2.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: EXCEL_EXT includes .xlsb but msoffcrypto may not handle binary workbook format consistently; low priority since detection falls back to not-encrypted.
download_zip uses only='unlocked' default but includes both 'unlocked' and 'ready' statuses - name is slightly misleading but behavior matches UI intent.
unlock endpoint returns 200 even when all file_ids are invalid/non-matched (unlocked=0, errors=[]) - acceptable but silent; consider surfacing a 'skipped' count.
seed_data_creation: Reused existing /tmp/locked.pdf and /tmp/plain.pdf; fixture regenerates if missing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_unlockvault.py cover security hardening (session_id validation, extension allowlist, file count cap, generic errors, Content-Disposition) + full regression flow. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_unlockvault.py -v. Frontend flow validated via Playwright: file-upload-input, password-list-textarea, match-passwords-btn, unlock-all-btn, filter-*, select-all-checkbox, delete-selected-btn, confirm-bulk-delete-btn, theme-toggle-btn, download-zip-btn all working.
